analysis.title: Americas Consumer Staples: NielsenIQ First Take: L4wk total store sales grew +2%, but Food & HPC sales growth decelerated sequentially
key_insights: NielsenIQ data for the week ending October 17, 2026 shows total store sales up +2% over the latest quad-week, with roughly stable growth in the latest 2 weeks versus the prior 2 weeks.
Over the latest quad-week, sales growth was led by Health & Beauty Care (+5%), Household Care (+4%), Grocery (+3%) and Frozen (+3%). Alcohol (-3%), Tobacco (-2%), Deli (-2%) and Meat (-1%) declined.

HPC sales growth slowed to +3.8% in the latest quad-week from +4.4% last month. Lower price growth was partly offset by higher volume growth. Sales on promotion were down 110bps y/y. The 2-year stacked trend moderated more significantly.
Within HPC, KMB led with double-digit sales growth. Volume growth was robust, while pricing declines were greater sequentially as price investments accelerated.
CHD, CL and KVUE posted modest sales growth acceleration. CHD and KVUE were primarily volume-led, while CL was primarily price-led with volumes up only slightly.
PG posted solid sales growth but slowed sequentially in both volume and pricing. PG continues to lead the group with mid-single-digit growth in the latest 2 weeks.
CLX lagged the group with sales declines over the L4wk, though trends were modestly better than last month.
In the latest 2 weeks, HPC sales growth broadly accelerated relative to the prior 2 weeks for KMB, CHD, CL, KVUE, PG and CLX.
Packaged Food sales decelerated to -1.3% in the latest quad-week from -0.9% last month, due to lower prices.

In Packaged Food, sales accelerated for GIS and MDLZ on higher volumes, and HRL tracked flat. Sales decelerated for CAG, KHC, SFD and TSN on lower volumes, for HSY on lower prices, and for OFRM on both lower prices and lower volumes.
On a 12-week basis, Packaged Food sales accelerated for GIS, while CAG, HRL, HSY, KHC, MDLZ, OFRM, SFD and TSN decelerated.

Non-alcoholic beverage $ sales trends largely accelerated on a 2-week versus 4-week basis. Energy drinks, CSDs, bottled water, sports drinks, coconut water, sparkling water and RTD coffee improved, while RTD tea worsened.
By company, MNST (ex-Bang) and COCO accelerated on a four-week basis versus last month, while KDP, KO, PEP and CELH decelerated.

Alcoholic beverages: beer and FMB/cider/seltzer improved on a 2-week versus 4-week basis, while wine and spirits were broadly stable. SAM and BF accelerated versus last month, while STZ and TAP were broadly stable.
Tobacco/nicotine: cigarette $ sales declines eased modestly in the latest 2 weeks versus the prior 4 weeks. PM and IMB accelerated versus last month, while MO and BAT were broadly stable.
Private label $ share change at the total store level was -0.2 pts y/y on a rolling 4-week basis, moderating from -0.3 pts in the prior two weeks.

sector_views.rationale: Sales growth of +3.8% in the L4wk, down from +4.4% last month, with price growth lower and volume higher. 2-year stacked trends moderated more.
Sales of -1.3% in the L4wk versus -0.9% last month on lower prices. Most covered names decelerated on a 12-week basis.
Non-alcoholic beverage $ sales trends largely accelerated on a 2-week versus 4-week basis, while alcoholic categories remain negative except spirits.
Cigarette $ sales declines eased to -2.7% in 2 weeks from -3.2% in 4 weeks.

risk_factors: Food volumes are declining at CAG, KHC, SFD and TSN, and price is a headwind at HSY and OFRM.
Price investments at KMB are accelerating, which is pushing price declines wider.
Alcohol and tobacco categories continue to decline y/y.
